 ORDER 1.
This is the SECOND application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code,1973 for grant of bail during trial.

The applicant is facing trial in connection with Crime No.134/2023 registered at Police Station Kanvan, District Dhar, for offence under Sections 376(D),
376 (2)(n), 292, 506, 34 of IPC and under Section 67 & 66 E of Information Technology Act.

2. His first application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 19.06.2023, passed in MCRC No.22946/2023, with liberty to renew the application after recording statement of the prosecutrix under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and have been falsely implicated in the present crime.
He also submits that the allegation of rape is only against the main accused Vikas and the present applicant was only said to be present at the spot.
There is no allegation regarding making video of the aforesaid offence i.e only against other accused Gabbu.

Investigation is over and charge-sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of trial will take sufficient long time.
Under these circumstances, prayer was made for grant of bail to the applicant.
4. Learned Govt. Advocate for the State has opposed the application but fairly admitted the fact that applicant was only standing at the place of incident.
5. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

6. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and the arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and on a perusal of the material available on record including the case diary,
without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
8.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Certified Copy as per rules.
